attributes.board_name: Kentucky Board of Licensure of Marriage and Family Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Without board review: programs provided/approved by AAMFT and state affiliates, academic courses, CE by COAMFTE-accredited institutions; other programs, online courses and presentations/publications need board approval

topics.who: Every 6 years (KRS 210.366); in addition to the annual hours unless board-preapproved

Part of the same 3-hour training within 3 years of initial licensure

rules.notes: One-year renewal period. Presenting max half of required hours; one publication per period. Renewal date not confirmed.
